The if filter is best-effort; the docs recommend the permission system for hard allow or deny rules. [↗](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks)
- `python.nameNormalization`: Names are lowercased and every run of ., - or _ becomes a single -, before lookups and comparisons (PEP 503): Friendly.Bard and friendly_bard are the same package. Read from the page source in pypa/packaging.python.org. [↗](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/name-normalization/)
- `python.namePattern`: The specification gives ^([A-Z0-9]|[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9._-]*[A-Z0-9])\Z run with re.IGNORECASE (PEP 508). [↗](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/name-normalization/)
- `python.projectFile`: The configuration file of a Python project, in the project root; tools keep their own settings in its [tool.<name>] tables. [↗](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/pyproject-toml/)
- `python.wheelExtension`: A wheel is a ZIP archive with the .whl extension; installing it unpacks files and runs no build code. Read from the page source in pypa/packaging.python.org. [↗](https://packaging.python.org/en/latest/specifications/binary-distribution-format/)
- `python.sourceDistributionExtensions`: ARCHIVE_EXTENSIONS of pip without .whl: the archives pip accepts from an index besides wheels (index/package_finder.py rejects any other extension), all of them built when installed. A standard sdist is named {name}-{version}.tar.gz with the name normalized (PEP 625, source-distribution-format.rst); older uploads use the other extensions and names that are not normalized. [↗](https://github.com/pypa/pip/blob/26.2.2/src/pip/_internal/utils/filetypes.py)
- `python.interpreter`: python [-bBdEhiIOPqRsSuvVWx?] [-c command | -m module-name | script | - ] [args]: -m and -c end the interpreter options, and what follows goes to the module or the command; -W arg, -X option and --check-hash-based-pycs mode take a value, the other options are flags. pip documents running itself as python -m pip, and as py -m pip with the Windows launcher (github.com/pypa/pip/blob/26.2.2/docs/html/cli/pip_install.rst). [↗](https://github.com/python/cpython/blob/v3.14.0/Doc/using/cmdline.rst)

## To review

Uncertain facts rest on incomplete official sources; disputed facts have official sources that disagree.

### npm · `installScripts.allowList.format` ❓ uncertain

The exact entry grammar (no semver ranges) is stated in accepted RFC 0054; the shipped docs describe entries only in prose.

- `Object keyed by name, name@version or name@v1 || v2 with true (allow) or false (deny); npm install-scripts approve writes pinned name@version entries` · [source](https://github.com/npm/rfcs/blob/main/accepted/0054-make-scripts-install-opt-in.md), verified 2026-10-28.

### npm · `sources.git.availableSince` ⚠️ disputed

The release notes add --allow-git in 11.9.0; the GitHub changelog says it was introduced in 11.10.0.

- Variant 1: `11.9.0` · [source](https://github.com/npm/cli/releases/tag/v11.9.0), verified 2026-10-28.
- Variant 2: `11.10.0` · [source](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-05-22-staged-publishing-and-new-install-time-controls-for-npm/), verified 2026-10-28.

### npm · `sources.remoteTarball.availableSince` ⚠️ disputed

The 11.14.0 release notes add the flag; the GitHub changelog dates it to 11.15.0, which also moved enforcement into the resolver. Treat 11.15.0 as the safe minimum.

- Variant 1: `11.14.0` · [source](https://github.com/npm/cli/releases/tag/v11.14.0), verified 2026-10-28.
- Variant 2: `11.15.0` · [source](https://github.blog/changelog/2026-05-22-staged-publishing-and-new-install-time-controls-for-npm/), verified 2026-10-28.

### npm · `sources.file.availableSince` ⚠️ disputed

The 11.14.0 release notes add the flag; the GitHub changelog dates it to 11.15.0, which also moved enforcement into the resolver. Treat 11.15.0 as the safe minimum.

- Variant 1: `11.14.0` · [source](https://github.com/npm/cli/releases/tag/v11.14.0), verified 2026-10-28.

- `2025-07-01` · [source](https://github.blog/changelog/2025-07-01-dependabot-supports-configuration-of-a-minimum-package-age/), verified 2026-10-28.

### Dependabot · `installScripts.defaultPolicy` ❓ uncertain

From dependabot-core source, not the docs: npm, Yarn and Bun lockfile updates run with scripts disabled; for pnpm only --lockfile-only was found. bundler, mix and pip may execute external code.

- all versions: `deny` · [source](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/blob/main/npm_and_yarn/lib/dependabot/npm_and_yarn/helpers.rb), verified 2026-10-28.

### Dependabot · `installScripts.disableAll` ❓ uncertain

Nothing to configure for JavaScript ecosystems: scripts are always disabled (source code). For bundler, mix and pip, external code execution is disabled automatically when registries are configured.

- `null` · [source](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/reference/supply-chain-security/dependabot-options-reference#insecure-external-code-execution), verified 2026-10-28.

### Dependabot · `extra.dayRange` ⚠️ disputed

Matters for opting out of the default cooldown; cooldown.exclude: ["*"] works under the documented precedence rule either way. The announcement does not state its author's role.

- Variant 1: `1 to 90 days` · [source](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/tutorials/secure-your-dependencies/optimizing-pr-creation-version-updates), verified 2026-10-28.
- Variant 2: `0 removes the cooldown` · [source](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/discussions/15582), verified 2026-10-28.

### Dependabot · `extra.transitiveGating` ❓ uncertain

Read from dependabot-core source.

- `Regular updates pass the cooldown to npm (11.10+), pnpm (10.16+) and Yarn Berry to hold back transitive dependencies; the Bun updater passes none` · [source](https://github.com/dependabot/dependabot-core/blob/main/npm_and_yarn/lib/dependabot/npm_and_yarn/file_updater/npm_lockfile_updater.rb), verified 2026-10-28.

### Environment · `npmRegistry.notFoundStatus` ❓ uncertain

The API description leaves its Errors section empty; a name that does not exist answered 404 with {"error":"Not found"} on 2026-10-29.

- `404` · [source](https://github.com/npm/registry/blob/main/docs/REGISTRY-API.md), verified 2026-10-29.

### Environment · `npmRegistry.search` ❓ uncertain

The description documents text, size (at most 250) and from. Results carried downloads.weekly on 2026-10-29, which the description does not list, and from was ignored, so one query returns at most 250 packages.

- `{"path":"/-/v1/search","maxSize":250,"weeklyDownloadsField":"downloads.weekly"}` · [source](https://github.com/npm/registry/blob/main/docs/REGISTRY-API.md), verified 2026-10-29.
